Hi Sara —

Thanks again for taking the time to speak today. Quick recap from our discovery: Acme Analytics is evaluating inference options to reduce per-token cost and improve 95th-percentile latency for customer-facing features. Key priorities you mentioned were predictable latency, private deployment options (VPC/on-prem), and tight observability around token-level costs.

Next step: schedule a 45–60 minute demo + technical deep-dive where we can show runtime performance, routing/rollback controls, and dig into private deployment architecture. Proposed times (all ET):
- Tue, Jun 15 — 11:00 AM ET
- Wed, Jun 16 — 2:00 PM ET
- Thu, Jun 17 — 9:00 AM ET

Do any of those work? Also, please confirm the attendee list and whether you prefer Zoom or Google Meet. I attached a short agenda (acme-demo-agenda.pdf) — let me know if you want us to add any specific topics.

If these look good, I can send a calendar invite with the Zoom link and loop in our technical lead (Vivek) for the deep-dive.

Best,
Marissa Cole
